messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-87461 -> 5xx rate spike on private-vpc-ingress (eu-west1). Rule: /v1/embeddings/upload 5m error rate > 8%. Recent error mix: 504, 502. Pager: oncall rotation.

maya: acked. I'm taking it. pulling logs and metrics now.

alex: oncall swap? I can help if you need takeover. ETA 2m.

oncall (maya): first checks: cluster ingress logs, SNAT/NAT gateway metrics, and gateway retries. runbook step1: grep ingress for 'upstream timeout' and check 95p latency. also check cloud NAT port usage.

maya: paste logs: `grep "upstream" /var/log/gateway/ingress.log | tail -n 20` -> repeated: "upstream read timeout" "connect timeout to 10.12.34.56:443". stack traces show long TCP handshake times.

sam: I see correlating cloud metrics: NAT SNAT ports at 96% on eu-west1-priv-1 for the last 6m. A lot of ephemeral ports consumed by concurrent uploads from a narrow set of IPs. Could be one large customer parallelizing uploads.

alex: If SNAT port exhaustion is the issue, short-term mitigations: 1) route heavy upload traffic to dedicated-ingest-eu pool, 2) reduce gateway retries, 3) add per-source-IP rate-limit.

maya: doing 2) now. patching gateway env: `kubectl set env deployment/gateway REQ_RETRIES=1 -n production` -> applied.

deploy-bot: Started scale job: autoscaler request -> dedicated-ingest-eu +2 nodes. job-id: scale-2026-04-05-179888.

sam: also enabling temporary IP rate-limit on Ingress: `nginx-ingress` config set `limit_req zone=perip burst=20 nodelay`. rolling out.

maya: confirmed NAT SNAT ports falling to 68% after routing and retry change. 5xx rate down to 3.2% over last 60s.

oncall (maya): creating PD incident record and customer-facing note. Impact: private deployment ingest failures for some eu-west1 customers (likely large parallel uploads). Severity: Sev2. ETA for full mitigation: 15m while scale finishes and rate-limits propagate.

sam: opening support ticket to suspected customer (AcmeCorp) to ask them to stagger uploads for next 30m. Also will propose long-term: connection pooling + dedicated egress per-tenant.

alex: will follow up with runbook PR to add SNAT port checks to automated health alerts (threshold at 80%).

oncall (maya): monitoring dashboards (errors, nat_port_usage, 95p latency). will update here in 10m and then write a short postmortem. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: PD-87461 acknowledged -> investigating. Assigned: maya. Current status: mitigation in progress, customer impact contained (partial).

maya: 10m status: 5xx rate stabilized <2%, NAT ports healthy, dedicated pool scale completed. closing immediate mitigation. preparing RCA notes and timeline.

maya: action items: (1) add SNAT port alert, (2) implement per-tenant egress isolation for heavy upload customers, (3) update docs for private-deploy runbook. I'll file follow-ups.

alex: thanks — good coordination.

maya: will file incident summary and link to PD ticket in #postmortems in the next hour.
